args.prompt:
Make a NEW KFB soft claymation ink blob character sheet, Deep Sea After Hours. The original reference PNGs guide the intact charcoal-plum goo anatomy, expressive filled sculpted eyelids, cream white sclera, distinct red iris and black pupil, and miniature prop modeling. Exactly six independent footless complete upright ink blobs in a 3-column by 2-row horizontal 1536×1024 true transparent PNG. Equal substantial scale. All props held or attached to their own body, all detached droplets inside generous gutters and canvas margins. No stage, floor, scenery, backdrop color, panel borders, text, labels or logos. Smooth softly satin clay with larger sparse hand-shaped marks, quiet cloth folds and clean smooth glass or glossy material. Avoid dense stipple, grit and crust. Keep organic thick rounded goo shapes and whole ink silhouette dominant, with minimal distinct costume or thematic prop. Teeth sit behind lips. Wide range of eyes, body attitudes and mouth shapes. Style and palette: Deep ocean indigo with contained amber and cyan bioluminescent accents, matte ink clay and smooth glass. The role cast in row-major order:
1. Male-read lanternfish maintenance worker. lean high comma, worried sideways gaze, tight lips. One compact cue: small warm luminous bulb on short forehead stalk and one smooth spare bulb in hand.
2. Female-read clam shift supervisor. wide squat body, unimpressed narrowed eyes and closed frown. One compact cue: small rounded clam shell collar and a thick clipboard.
3. Male-read tube worm vent regulator. tall upright droplet, one eyebrow lifted and pursed mouth. One compact cue: small pale rolled tube at flank and a short chunky thermometer with red tip.
4. Female-read bioluminescent signal keeper. round asymmetric pear, upturned eager eyes, small delighted smile. One compact cue: short bead antennae and one sealed cyan lantern.
5. Male-read sediment cleaner. broad low droop, tired lids, flat closed lips. One compact cue: tiny smooth silt scoop with a small pale mound and broad short brush.
6. Male-read break-time resident. lean wobbly blob, brows raised and startled round mouth. One compact cue: compact thick-walled deep-sea mug with handle.
Six distinct readable stand-alone figures, original archetypal props, very clear alpha gutters. No copied reference costume, wings or eyepatches.

material_change: Gentle charcoal/plum satin clay with broader sparse surface marks and smoother liquid, plastic and glass props.
